description: Assign a role to a user, with optional expiry and scoped permissions.

user_id.description: Path parameter: ID of the user receiving the role

role.description: Role to assign: admin, moderator, vendor, or support

assigned_by.description: User ID of the admin performing the assignment

expires_at.description: Optional ISO8601 datetime when the role expires

permissions.description: Optional list of specific permission overrides
